searchText: I just want to hear some feedback about this worth being continuing, so from what I have measured is that I'm getting 2 ZK verifications a second on the CORTEX m33 I might be looking over something please don't be afraid to be critical. $ ~ zkmcu boot: heap=384K sys=150MHz core=cortex-m33 alloc=tlsf stark-prover-threshold N=64 value=37 threshold=100 [boot] prove start [boot] N=64 stack=4672 heap_base=0 heap_peak=65880 cycles=72[2] stark_prove start [2] stark_prove: cycles=7188650 us=47924 ms=47 proof_bytes=5787 security_bits=21 ok=true [2] stark_verify: cycles=4348036 us=28986 ms=28 ok=true [2] prove_verify_total: prove_us=47924 verify_us=28986 total_us=76911 total_ms=76 heap_after=10 ok=true [3] stark_prove start [3] stark_prove: cycles=7192762 us=47951 ms=47 proof_bytes=5787 security_bits=21 ok=true [3] stark_verify: cycles=4339596 us=28930 ms=28 ok=true [3] prove_verify_total: prove_us=47951 verify_us=28930 total_us=76882 total_ms=76 heap_after=10 ok=true [4] stark_prove start [4] stark_prove: cycles=7201861 us=48012 ms=48 proof_bytes=5787 security_bits=21 ok=true [4] stark_verify: cycles=4332667 us=28884 ms=28 ok=true [4] prove_verify_total: prove_us=48012 verify_us=28884 total_us=76896 total_ms=76 heap_after=10 ok=true [5] stark_prove start And it's consistent over 2k+ iterations All below 512KB ram I mean I feel like that is pretty insane I'm not gonna lie 12.9 per second It's 21 bits but I feel like with compression I can get more out of it
